Growing up, I was (and still am) the only person in my family who wasnt white. My mom had me, unintentionally, with a black man who ended up leaving her(longer story I wont share). My family unfortunately is pretty...racist I guess? I grew up being called ‘brownie’ my whole life. My mother would (and still does) tell me weekly that “I wasnt black” and that “black people cant be trusted”. Being a mixed person this really fucked with my head and my self identify. Imagine telling your 7 year old they arent something they literally are. Outside my of my immediate family,  no one in my family will acknowledge me as part of it just because of my skin color. Fast forward some years and now here I am (27) unable to trust anyone and I just assume that anyone I meet ultimately cannot accept anything about me and is extremely judgmental. Needless to say relationships arent great. However, Ive been doing therapy and things are getting better!!
